title: Free tutorial: Your first SPL search
summary: Count, then pivot: your first searches in a SIEM's search language.

next.title: Seminar 2: Log search and detection as code

script.intro: Welcome. A SIEM is only as good as the questions you ask it. Here are your first two searches in SPL.
script.outro: Count, then pivot: that is most of threat hunting. Seminar 2 goes on to rules and the KQL version.
steps: Read the setting so you know the company, the date and the time zone. Then open the evidence in the case folder.

SPL reads left to right: a search, then a pipe, then a command that works on the results. Stats count by src_ip groups the failures by address, and sort minus count puts the biggest first. Then pivot: take the address you found and search for it again, this time for a success. Field names come from the parsed log: action, src_ip, user, auth_method. Click any field name in the results to add it to the search.
Count, then pivot: that is most of threat hunting. Seminar 2 goes on to rules and the KQL version.
